Allow tags that look like secrets: Allow tags that look like secrets
Max. age of a source value (s): Max. age of a source value (s)
Max. distinct values per dynamic tag: Max. distinct values per dynamic tag
Max. distinct values per tag key: Max. distinct values per tag key
Overwrite existing settings of this inst: Overwrite existing settings of this instance
Write last skipped value before a change: Write last skipped value before a change
confirm_createdb: Create the database on the server? An existing database is never changed.
confirm_migration: Configure the listed states for this instance now? The influxdb instance is not changed.
err_default_not_allowed: Default must be one of the allowed values (or allow other values)
err_field: Letters, digits and '_', starting with a letter; not a reserved name
err_key_not_in_catalog: Choose a key from the tag catalog (instance settings → Tags)
err_number_or_empty: Enter a number or leave empty
err_retention: Use units h, d, w, mo, y (e.g. 30d) or none
err_table: Table names must not start with '_'
err_url: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://
err_value_not_in_catalog: Value not allowed for this key (see tag catalog)
tip_API token: InfluxDB 3 token (apiv3_...). Stored encrypted, never logged. On Core every token is an admin token – on Enterprise use a token limited to this database.
tip_Alias ID: Writes the data under this id (state_id tag / table) – useful after replacing a device.
tip_Allow SQL/InfluxQL queries via sendT: Only read statements (SELECT, WITH, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN) are accepted.
tip_Allow tags that look like secrets: Only enable if you are sure the tag values contain no passwords, tokens or personal data.
tip_Allowed native keys for templates: Comma separated keys usable as {native.key}. Other native values are never exposed.
tip_Allowed query senders: Comma separated adapter instances allowed to run queries, e.g. admin, javascript.0. Empty = all instances.
tip_Block secrets in tags: Tags looking like passwords, tokens, session ids or e-mail addresses are not written unless allowed per state.
tip_Block time (ms): After a written value, new values are held back for this time; the newest is written afterwards. 0 = off.
tip_Buffer mode: Memory: pending data in RAM, saved to disk on shutdown. Disk: every batch is stored on disk before sending and survives crashes (more disk writes).
tip_CA certificate (PEM): Optional CA certificate that signed the server certificate (PEM text).
tip_Check connection: Tests URL, token and database with the values entered above (also before saving). The result never contains the token.
tip_Compress requests (gzip): Request bodies above 1 KiB are gzip-compressed.
tip_Connection check interval (s): How often the connection is checked via /ping.
tip_Database: Target database. Letters, digits, '_' and '-'. It is created implicitly by the first write; its retention is fixed by whoever creates it.
tip_Debounce (ms): A value is written only after it was stable for this time. 0 = off.
tip_Debug logs for this state: Logs every decision of the filters at log level debug.
tip_Default aggregation: Used by getHistory if the caller does not specify one. Aggregation runs in InfluxDB (date_bin).
tip_Default row limit of getHistory: Used when the caller gives no limit/count.
tip_Enable dynamic tags {state:<id>}: Per-state tag values may read another state, e.g. {state:0_userdata.0.mode}. Every new value creates new series – use with care.
tip_Fast acknowledgement (no_sync): The server answers before the data is written to its WAL. Faster, but data in flight can be lost if the server crashes.
tip_Filter by ack: Which values are written depending on the ack flag.
tip_Filter by quality: Write all values or only values with quality 0 (good).
tip_First retry delay (ms): Exponential backoff with jitter starts with this delay for network errors, 429 and 5xx. Validation errors (4xx) are never retried.
tip_Flush interval (ms): A batch is sent at the latest after this time.
tip_Ignore values above: Numbers above this limit are not written. Empty = off.
tip_Ignore values below: Numbers below this limit are not written. Empty = off.
tip_Ignore zero: Values equal to 0 are not written.
tip_Log changes only: Unchanged values are not written (except for the re-log interval).
tip_Logged rejections per minute: Rate limit for warnings about records rejected by the server.
tip_Max. age of a source value (s): Older source values are treated as missing (tag omitted). 0 = unlimited.
tip_Max. age of buffered data (h): Older buffered batches are discarded and counted as dropped.
tip_Max. batch size (bytes): Upper limit of one request body (server limit 10 MiB, maximum here 8 MiB).
tip_Max. columns per table: Column limit of the server (Core default 500, including time and tags).
tip_Max. disk buffer (bytes): Limit of the disk buffer in iobroker-data/influx-v3.N/spool.
tip_Max. distinct values per tag key: Cardinality protection for variable tags; further values are written as _other.
tip_Max. memory buffer (bytes): Limit of buffered data in RAM.
tip_Max. records in memory: Limit of buffered records in RAM.
tip_Max. records per batch: A batch is sent as soon as it contains this many records.
tip_Max. retry delay (ms): Upper limit of the backoff delay.
tip_Max. rows of user queries: Rows of 'query' results above this limit are cut off (truncated=true).
tip_Max. send time on shutdown (ms): Time to send pending data when the instance stops; the rest stays in the disk buffer.
tip_Max. tables: Table limit of the server (Core default 2000 for the whole server).
tip_Max. text length (bytes): Longer texts are rejected and counted (server limit 1 MB).
tip_Minimal change (numbers): Numeric changes smaller than this are not written. 0 = off.
tip_Objects and arrays: Store JSON values as text or reject them.
tip_Overwrite existing settings of this: Otherwise states already configured for this instance are skipped.
tip_Parallel write requests: 1 keeps the order of the batches strictly.
tip_Query timeout (ms): Maximum duration of getHistory and SQL queries.
tip_Re-log unchanged value (s): With 'changes only': write the current value again after this time even if unchanged. 0 = off.
tip_Remove tag keys: Comma separated keys removed from global/automatic tags for this state.
tip_Request timeout (ms): Maximum duration of one write or ping request.
tip_Retention for a new database: Only used by the button. Examples: 30d, 52w, 1y, none. Core cannot change the retention of an existing database.
tip_Retry after authentication error (ms: After 401/403/404 the data is kept and writing is retried after this time.
tip_Round to decimal places: Numbers are rounded before writing. Empty = no rounding.
tip_Save memory buffer on shutdown: Unsent records are written to disk when the instance stops and sent after the next start.
tip_Server URL: Protocol, host and port of InfluxDB 3, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8181. A path prefix is allowed for reverse proxies.
tip_Server edition: Core and Enterprise use the native v3 HTTP API. 'Automatic' detects the edition via /ping. Cloud is experimental and write-only.
tip_Source influxdb instance: Instance of the classic ioBroker.influxdb adapter.
tip_Statistics update interval (s): How often the info.* states are updated.
tip_Store ack: Applies when metadata placement is not 'not stored'.
tip_Store as: Automatic uses common.type. Booleans stored as number (1/0) can share a table with numbers.
tip_Store from: Applies when metadata placement is not 'not stored'.
tip_Store q: Applies when metadata placement is not 'not stored'.
tip_Subscribe to all states from: From this number of logged states the adapter subscribes to all state changes instead of individual ones (fewer subscriptions, more events).
tip_Table (empty = automatic): Grouped mode: shared table of this state (one value type per table). Per-state mode: own table name instead of the state id.
tip_Table for booleans: Default table of boolean states (value column Boolean).
tip_Table for numbers: Default table of numeric states (value column Float64).
tip_Table for texts: Default table of text, JSON and mixed states (value column Utf8).
tip_Table model: Grouped (recommended): shared tables, state_id as tag – good for Grafana and many states. Per state: one table per state like the classic adapter, limited by the server's table limit (Core: 2000).
tip_Table rules: First matching rule wins. Pattern with * and ? is compared with the role or the id. By default a rule applies to numbers only, so a table never gets two value types.
tip_Tag key style: lower_snake_case turns 'Sub-Type' into 'sub_type' (SQL without quotes). 'Keep' writes keys as entered (SQL needs "Sub-Type").
tip_Use automatic tags: room, function, unit … as enabled in the instance settings.
tip_Value column: Name of the field that stores the value.
tip_Value column (per-state mode): Only in per-state mode; empty = instance setting.
tip_Verify TLS certificate: Disable only for self-signed certificates you trust; better provide the CA certificate below.
tip_When the buffer is full: Drop the oldest batch or reject new records. Every dropped record is counted in info.droppedRecords.
tip_Write adapter statistics into Influx: Writes counters into table iobroker_adapter_stats of the same database at every statistics interval.
tip_Write current value on start: When logging starts, the current value is written with the start time.
tip_Write last skipped value before a ch: Keeps chart lines flat until the real change (like the classic adapter).
tip_Write mode: Batched: records are collected and sent together (recommended). Direct: every record is sent immediately (more requests).
tip_ack: Store the ack flag as boolean field, as tag or not at all.
tip_from (source): Store the writing instance. As tag it creates one series per source (high cardinality).
tip_fsync disk buffer files: Forces the data onto the storage medium (safer after power loss, slower on SD cards).
tip_name (common.name): Almost unique per state – increases cardinality.
tip_q (quality): Store the quality code as integer field, as tag or not at all.
tip_state_tags_catalog: Keys and values come from the tag catalog of the instance (Tags tab). Other values only where the key allows them; such values may contain templates, e.g. {id.segment[2]}.
tip_tag_catalog: Central list of tag keys and their standard values. In the object settings only these keys can be chosen, with the listed values (other values only where allowed). A default value is written for every state that uses global tags.
txt_defaults: Defaults for new per-state configurations (Objects → gear icon of a state).
txt_guarantee: Delivery is at-least-once within these limits; repeated sending of the same record overwrites it in InfluxDB (no duplicates). Exactly-once is not guaranteed.
txt_meta_change: Changing the table model, table names or metadata placement creates new series/tables; existing data is never modified.
txt_migration: Copies the per-state settings of an existing influxdb instance to this instance – only when you press 'Apply'. The influxdb instance and its settings are not changed, historical data is not copied.
txt_notalive: Start the instance to see diagnostics.
txt_perstate_warn: Warning: InfluxDB 3 Core allows only 2000 tables per server. The adapter refuses new tables above 'Max. tables' and warns at 80 %.
txt_precision: Timestamps are written with precision=millisecond (ioBroker state.ts). No conversion to nanoseconds is done.
txt_proxy: HTTP proxies are not supported in this version – connect directly or via a reverse proxy URL.
txt_templates_catalog: Templates (only for catalog keys that allow other values): {id}, {id.segment[N]} (negative N counts from the end), {id.adapter}, {id.instance}, {common.unit}, {common.role}, {common.name}, {native.KEY}, {enum.room}, {enum.function}, {parent.device}, {parent.channel}, {state:ID} (dynamic). Order: catalog defaults → automatic → per state → excluded keys.
